description: Open a checkout that adds 12 months of updates to paid licenses whose updates end within 90 days (or ended). Leave entitlement_ids out to renew every license that's due; ids come from list_owned. The version already installed keeps working either way. Priced at the renewal price (about half). The owner pays in the browser like any checkout. Needs the checkout:create permission.

coupon.description: Not accepted: discount codes don't apply to renewals (a code given here is refused, not ignored).

entitlement_ids.description: Licenses to renew (list_owned shows ids). Default: all that are due.

name: renew_updates
title: Renew updates for 12 months
